messages:
sarah.sales: Hey team — ACME Bank POC update. They asked for BYO-CMK with HSM backed keys, 4k TPS target for inference calls during peak. They want rotation every 30 days and audit logs retained 2 years. Can infra + security confirm feasibility and cost delta?

mike.se: 4k TPS is aggressive but doable with Dedicated. Need to know average token count per request and whether they want synchronous encryption for every request or only for model checkpoints.

olga.crypto: For BYO-CMK + HSM we need key wrap/un-wrap per request if they send ciphertext. If they provide raw keys via KMS API we can do envelope encryption and cache DEKs — that avoids HSM on every token.

tim.security: Important: customer requires FIPS 140-2 validated HSM and customer-controlled rotation window. We need KMS flow that supports importable key material and KMS API call audit events forwarded to their SIEM. Also flag: cross-region replication banned.

anna-legal: Also on the questionnaire they circled: 'Do you have KMS access separation, dual control for key deletion?' They want an attestation and a sample SOW clause for key custody. I can draft but need specifics from infra.

mike.se: For cost: if we hit HSM ops per-request it balloons. Two options: 1) envelope encryption + DEK caching (best perf, minimal HSM ops), 2) HSM sign/wrap per request (highest security but expensive and higher latency). For 4k TPS, option 1 seems only practical.

olga.crypto: Agree. We can recommend using AEAD with DEK cached for X minutes + attested KMS unwrap on rotation. Rotation every 30 days ok — note we must provide replay-protected rotation handshake so previous DEKs are expired safely.

tim.security: Also need to confirm key rotation support for customer-managed rotation schedule and ability to force-rotate from their side. And export of audit logs (CloudTrail-like) to their S3.

ops-bot: Note: Dedicated pool availability in eu-west-1 can support up to 6k TPS for current instance types with planned autoscale. Reserved capacity quote required.

sarah.sales: Can someone scope a quick options doc (perf + cost + SOW bullets) I can send today to the customer? They asked for a narrowed proposal by EOD.

mike.se: I’ll do perf/cost numbers. Need assumed payload size: 500 tokens avg generation (~1.5kB) and 50ms model decode per token. If that’s accurate I’ll run sims.

olga.crypto: I’ll write the KMS/HSM flow diagram and required API calls. Also include a small note on attestation options (cloud HSM vs on-prem HSM gateway).

anna-legal: I’ll draft the SOW snippets and dual-control language. One ask: do we support split custody or key escrow? If not, I’ll mark as exception.

tim.security: We do not currently offer customer-side split custody for BYO keys in hosted mode. We can document the exception and propose Dedicated + HSM proxy as an alternative.

sarah.sales: Perfect. Mike/Olga/Anna — ping me the drafts here. I’ll consolidate and reply to ACME. :thumbsup:

mike.se: sending numbers in 30m.

olga.crypto: diagram + API sketch in ~45m.

anna-legal: SOW draft in 1h.

sarah.sales: one more: customer asked about emergency rotation SLA. Can we promise 4h key revoke + failover to a fallback key?

mike.se: We can implement fast failover if they allow a pre-provisioned fallback key (DEK wrap key). Otherwise 4h for HSM import + propagate might be optimistic. I’ll call out tradeoffs.

tim.security: Also logging: we can push logs to their SIEM via streaming within 15 minutes, but legal may need to accept logs containing tokenized request IDs only (no plaintext inputs). We should include that caveat.

sarah.sales: Great — thanks team. I’ll wait for drafts and then loop in sales execs and ACME CISO.

ops-bot: reminder: please attach any SOW/diagram PDF to the thread before 18:00 UTC for centralized storage.
